Disaster recovery and emergency civilian grid power: only academic modelling (engrxiv, 2024) and H.R. 1009 (2023, never enacted) found; no MW commitment. Not written.
Hydrogen and ammonia: searches returned only utility-scale renewable hydrogen and ammonia projects (Jordan, Morocco, China, Oman). No microreactor-specific agreement found. Not written.

Prodigy and Des Nedhe remote mines (2024 MOU): 15-45 MWe per remote mine is a sizing estimate from the 2024 release, and the release itself returned HTTP 403. Prodigy 2026 items already ship in news.json. Not written.
Chalk River GFP (chalk-river-mmr): CNSC project page reports status Paused; no 2026 resumption found. Shipped status left as is, not fetched directly.

Type E regions: Faroe Islands considered; no fetched 2025-or-later tariff or load figure found (SEV pages and Wikipedia only, dated). No region record written. Other candidate regions were already on skip/regions.json.
